_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: success 0.80 standard, 0.78 new, 10% of the new arm switched

agreement.claim: both engines report the same differences, Newcombe and Wald limits, and conclusions
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0, R's written-out Newcombe interval against statsmodels'. harness/trials_examples.test.py shows the ITT difference sits closer to 0 than the per-protocol one on average.

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: The tolerances keep the estimates above the margin (-0.10) in expectation; they do not separate -0.02 from 0, which the trial is not designed to do. Measured by harness/trials_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 (MALLARD_SEEDS=100); CI reruns it on seeds 0 to 49 at the same order statistic (owner decisions E5, E6).
